271: By God's mercy the light of knowledge dawns in the mind;
by His kindness the lotus of the heart blossoms.
God dwells in the mind of the one with whom He is pleased,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਇਆ ਤੇ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥
and by God's mercy a person's understanding becomes good.
O God, all treasures lie in Your glance of grace;
no one has ever gained anything by his own effort.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਥ ॥
O Lord, O Master, beings attach themselves to whatever You attach them to.
ਨਾਨਕ ਇਨ ਕੈ; ਕਛੂ ਨ ਹਾਥ ॥੮॥੬॥
O Nanak, nothing lies in the power of these beings. ॥8॥6॥
That boundless Lord is beyond reach and unfathomable.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ; ਸੁ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whoever remembers Him is freed from the net of vices.
Listen, friend, Nanak makes this plea:
the account of the virtues of the holy is astonishing. ॥1॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਤ ॥
In the company of the holy, faces grow bright with honour;
in the company of the holy, all the filth of vice is wiped away.
In the company of the holy, pride goes,
and the highest knowledge shows itself.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਬੁਝੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥
In the company of the holy, God is felt to dwell close by,
and so every evil leaning is settled and done with.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਰਤਨੁ ॥
In the company of the holy, one finds the jewel of the Name,
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਏਕ ਊਪਰਿ ਜਤਨੁ ॥
and strives only to meet the one Lord.
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬਰਨੈ ਕਉਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ॥
What person can describe the greatness of the holy?
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, the glory of the holy becomes equal to the glory of God. ॥1॥
In the company of the holy, one meets the Lord who is beyond the reach of the senses,
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਆਵਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
In the company of the holy, the five vices come under control,
because one tastes the nectar of the Name.
In the company of the holy, one becomes the dust of everyone's feet,
and speaks sweet words to all.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, the mind does not run off in any direction,
and it gains steadiness at the Lord's feet.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
In the company of the holy, one stays unstained by Maya,
and, O Nanak, the Timeless Lord is merciful to him. ॥2॥
In the company of the holy, all enemies come to look like friends,
because there one's own heart becomes very clean.
In the company of the holy, enmity towards anyone ceases,
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਬੀਗਾ ਪੈਰੁ ॥
and one's foot never steps on a wrong path.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
In the company of the holy, no one appears bad,
because everywhere one knows only the Lord of highest bliss.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਾਹੀ ਹਉ ਤਾਪੁ ॥
In the company of the holy, the fever of self-importance does not remain;
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਜੈ ਸਭੁ ਆਪੁ ॥
in the company of the holy, one gives up all sense of self.
God Himself knows the greatness of the holy,
for, O Nanak, a firm love is formed between the holy and God. ॥3॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, the mind never wanders,
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
because there one always enjoys peace.
In the company of the holy, one receives the Name, a thing beyond the senses,
and bears this rank that is so hard to bear.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਬਸੈ ਥਾਨਿ ਊਚੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, one lives on a high spiritual plane,
and stays joined to the feet of the Timeless Lord.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਸਭਿ ਧਰਮ ॥
In the company of the holy, one comes to understand all one's duties well,
and sees only the supreme Lord everywhere.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਪਾਏ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
In the company of the holy, one finds the treasure of the Name;
O Nanak, I give myself in offering to the holy. ॥4॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਭ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, one saves one's whole lineage from vice,
and carries one's friends, companions and family across.
ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸੋ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, one finds that wealth
ਜਿਸੁ ਧਨ ਤੇ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਵਰਸਾਵੈ ॥
by gaining which every person becomes renowned.
In the company of the holy, even Dharamraj serves,
and the gods too speak one's praise.
In the company of the holy, sins depart,
because there people sing the Lord's virtues, which give deathless life.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸ੍ਰਬ ਥਾਨ ਗੰਮਿ ॥
In the company of the holy, every place comes within reach;
272: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸਫਲ ਜਨੰਮ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, in the company of the holy, human birth bears its fruit. ॥5॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨਹੀ ਕਛੁ ਘਾਲ ॥
In the company of the holy, there is no need for the toil of austerities,
because the very sight of them makes the heart blossom.
In the company of the holy, one destroys one's sins,
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
In the company of the holy, one is at ease in this world and the next,
and one separated from the Lord meets Him again.
Whatever one desires, that fruit one obtains;
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
from the company of the holy no one leaves unfulfilled.
The supreme Lord dwells in the hearts of the holy;
O Nanak, hearing teaching from the tongue of the holy, one is saved from vice. ॥6॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਸੁਨਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
May I hear the Lord's Name in the company of the holy,
and there sing the Lord's virtues.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਨ ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰੈ ॥
In the company of the holy, the Lord is not forgotten by the mind;
in the company of the holy, one surely escapes from vice.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਲਗੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
In the company of the holy, the Lord begins to seem dear,
ਸਾਧੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਡੀਠਾ ॥
and He comes to be seen in every body.
In the company of the holy, we become obedient to the Lord's command,
and our spiritual state is set right.
ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ; ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ॥
In the company of the holy, all diseases are wiped out;
O Nanak, it is by great good fortune that one meets the holy. ॥7॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਮਹਿਮਾ; ਬੇਦ ਨ ਜਾਨਹਿ ॥
Even the Vedas do not know the greatness of the holy;
they relate only as much as they have heard.
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ; ਤਿਹੁ ਗੁਣ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
The likeness of the holy lies beyond the three qualities;
the holy can be likened only to the Lord who pervades all.
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ ਕਾ; ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤ ॥
The glory of the holy cannot be measured;
it can only ever be called endless.
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਊਚ ਤੇ ਊਚੀ ॥
The glory of the holy is far higher than all other glory,
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਮੂਚ ਤੇ ਮੂਚੀ ॥
ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਸਾਧ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
The glory of the holy befits the holy alone,
ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧ ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਭੇਦੁ ਨ ਭਾਈ ॥੮॥੭॥
for, O Nanak, there is no difference at all between the holy and God, brother. ॥8॥7॥
One in whose mind the ever-lasting Lord dwells, and whose mouth repeats that same Lord,
ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਪੇਖੈ; ਏਕਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
who sees no one anywhere but the one Lord,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਇਹ ਲਛਣ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, by these qualities that person becomes a knower of God. ॥1॥
The knower of God stays always unstained by vice,
as the lotus growing in water stays clean of the mud.
The knower of God burns away all sins and stays clear of them,
as the sun dries up every moisture.
The knower of God looks on all with the same eye,
ਜੈਸੇ ਰਾਜ ਰੰਕ ਕਉ; ਲਾਗੈ ਤੁਲਿ ਪਵਾਨ ॥
as the wind touches king and pauper alike.
The knower of God keeps an unbroken steadiness,
ਜਿਉ ਬਸੁਧਾ; ਕੋਊ ਖੋਦੈ. ਕੋਊ ਚੰਦਨ ਲੇਪ ॥
like the earth, which one man digs up and another smears with sandalwood.
This is the quality of the knower of God,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕ ਕਾ; ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, like the inborn nature of fire, which burns away the dirt of everything. ॥1॥
The knower of God is the purest of the pure,
as dirt can never stay in water.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਮਨਿ ਹੋਇ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ॥
In the mind of the knower of God the light dawns that the Lord is present everywhere,
as the sky spreads everywhere over the earth.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ੍ਰੁ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
To the knower of God friend and enemy are the same,
because there is no pride within him.
The knower of God is the highest of all in spiritual state,
ਮਨਿ ਅਪਨੈ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੀਚਾ ॥
yet in his own mind he counts himself the lowest of all.
Only those people become knowers of God,
O Nanak, whom the Lord Himself fashions as such. ॥2॥
The knower of God lives as the dust of everyone's feet;
the knower of God has recognised spiritual joy.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਮਇਆ ॥
The knower of God is glad towards everyone,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਤੇ; ਕਛੁ ਬੁਰਾ ਨ ਭਇਆ ॥
and he does no bad deed.
The knower of God always looks on everyone alike;
273: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ; ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਬਰਸੀ ॥
from his glance nectar rains on all.
The knower of God is free of Maya's bonds,
and his way of living is clear of vice.
Divine knowledge is the food of the knower of God;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, the attention of the knower of God stays joined to the Timeless Lord. ॥3॥
The knower of God rests his hope on the one Lord;
the high spiritual state of the knower of God never perishes.
Humility stays lodged in the heart of the knower of God,
and he is always eager to do good to others.
The entanglement of Maya does not take hold of the mind of the knower of God,
because he can seize the wandering mind and hold it back.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ॥
Whatever happens seems good to the knower of God,
and so his human birth is fully fruitful.
In the company of the knower of God everyone is carried across,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਪੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੪॥
for, O Nanak, through the knower of God the whole world begins to repeat the Lord's Name. ॥4॥
In the heart of the knower of God lives love of the one Lord alone,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਬਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੰਗ ॥
and so God stays close beside the knower of God.
The Name is the support in the mind of the knower of God,
and the Name is his family.
The knower of God is always watchful against the assault of vice,
and gives up the thinking that says 'I, I'.
In the mind of the knower of God dwells the Lord of highest bliss,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ ਘਰਿ; ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ॥
and so in the home of his heart there is always joy.
The knower of God stays settled in peace and calm;
ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਨਹੀ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, this high state of the knower of God never perishes. ॥5॥
The knower of God becomes an intimate of the Timeless Lord,
and loves the one Lord alone.
The mind of the knower of God is always free of worry,
and his teaching makes others pure.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ॥
Only the one whom God Himself makes so becomes a knower of God;
great is the renown of the knower of God.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ ਦਰਸੁ; ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
The sight of the knower of God is had by great good fortune;
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ; ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈਐ ॥
let us always give ourselves in offering to the knower of God.
Even Shiva and the other gods go searching for the knower of God;
O Nanak, the Timeless Lord Himself is the form of the knower of God. ॥6॥
No price can be set on the virtues of the knower of God;
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੈ; ਸਗਲ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
every virtue is within the knower of God.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਕਉਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਭੇਦੁ ॥
Who can find out the secret of the high life of the knower of God?
It is fitting always to bow before the knower of God.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਕਥਿਆ ਨ ਜਾਇ. ਅਧਾਖੵਰੁ ॥
Not even half a letter of the greatness of the knower of God can be told;
the knower of God is worthy of the worship of all.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਮਿਤਿ; ਕਉਨੁ ਬਖਾਨੈ ॥
Who can estimate the measure of the life of the knower of God?
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
Only a knower of God like him knows his state.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ॥
The virtues of the knower of God have no end or boundary;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਨਮਸਕਾਰੁ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, stay always fallen at the feet of the knower of God. ॥7॥
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਭ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
The knower of God is the maker of the whole world;
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਦ ਜੀਵੈ. ਨਹੀ ਮਰਤਾ ॥
he lives for ever and never enters the round of birth and death.
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਮੁਕਤਿ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
The knower of God shows the way to liberation and gives the higher spiritual life;
he is the perfect Being and the Creator.
The knower of God is the master of the masterless,
ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕਾ; ਸਭ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਾਥੁ ॥
and gives his help to all.
All this visible world belongs to the knower of God;
274: ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਕੀ ਸੋਭਾ; ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ਬਨੀ ॥
Only a knower of God can tell the greatness of a knower of God;
ਨਾਨਕ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ; ਸਰਬ ਕਾ ਧਨੀ ॥੮॥੮॥
O Nanak, the knower of God is the master of all beings. ॥8॥8॥
One who keeps the Name of the Timeless Lord always set in his heart,
and sees the Lord present in all,
who bows to his Master moment by moment,
O Nanak, he is the real 'untouched one', and he carries all beings across. ॥1॥
One who does not let falsehood touch his tongue,
who keeps in his mind a longing to see the Timeless Lord;
ਪਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਅ ਰੂਪੁ; ਨ ਪੇਖੈ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ॥
who does not look with his eyes on the beauty of another man's wife,
who serves good people and loves the company of the holy;
ਕਰਨ ਨ ਸੁਨੈ; ਕਾਹੂ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ॥
who does not listen with his ears to slander of anyone,
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਜਾਨੈ; ਆਪਸ ਕਉ ਮੰਦਾ ॥
but counts himself worse than all others;
who by the Guru's grace pushes away the pull of Maya,
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਸਨਾ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
and from whose mind the mind's craving departs;
ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਜਿਤ; ਪੰਚ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
who keeps his senses in hand and stays clear of all five vices,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕੋਟਿ ਮਧੇ; ਕੋ ਐਸਾ ਅਪਰਸ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, among millions hardly one such person can be called 'untouched'. ॥1॥
The real Vaishnav is the one with whom the Lord Himself is pleased,
ਬਿਸਨ ਕੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ; ਹੋਇ ਭਿੰਨ ॥
who stays unstained by the influence of the Lord's Maya.
One who performs religious deeds without desiring their fruit,
the dharma of that Vaishnav is pure.
ਕਾਹੂ ਫਲ ਕੀ ਇਛਾ; ਨਹੀ ਬਾਛੈ ॥
One who has no wish for any fruit at all,
who stays absorbed in devotion and kirtan alone,
in whose mind and body the remembrance of the Lord dwells,
who is compassionate to all beings,
who fixes the Name in his own mind and leads others to repeat it,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਓਹੁ ਬੈਸਨੋ; ਪਰਮ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, that Vaishnav attains the highest rank. ॥2॥
The real Bhagauti, worshipper of the Lord, is one whose heart holds love for devotion to the Lord,
and who gives up the company of all evildoers;
from whose mind every kind of delusion is wiped out,
who worships the supreme Lord knowing Him to be present everywhere,
who in the company of the holy removes the filth of sins from his mind,
ਤਿਸੁ ਭਗਉਤੀ ਕੀ; ਮਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਵੈ ॥
the understanding of that Bhagauti becomes high.
ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ; ਕਰੈ ਨਿਤ ਨੀਤਿ ॥
One who remembers the Lord day after day,
who gives up his mind and body for love of the Lord,
who settles the Lord's feet in his heart,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਐਸਾ ਭਗਉਤੀ; ਭਗਵੰਤ ਕਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, such a Bhagauti finds the Lord. ॥3॥
The real pandit is one who instructs his own mind,
and searches within himself for the Lord's Name.
One who tastes the sweet flavour of the Lord's Name,
ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕੈ ਉਪਦੇਸਿ; ਜਗੁ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
by that pandit's teaching the world gains spiritual life.
One who settles talk of the Lord's praise in his heart,
ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
that pandit does not come again into birth and death.
One who understands the Lord as the root of the Vedas, Puranas and Smritis,
who knows that this whole visible world rests on the unseen Lord;
who gives teaching to all four castes,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਉਸੁ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਅਦੇਸੁ ॥੪॥
O Nanak, to that pandit we always bow our heads. ॥4॥
The Name is the root mantra of all mantras and gives knowledge to all;
ਚਹੁ ਵਰਨਾ ਮਹਿ; ਜਪੈ ਕੋਊ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
let anyone from any of the four castes repeat the Name and see.
ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜਪੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
Whoever repeats it, his life is raised high,
but only a rare person obtains it, in the company of the holy.
If the Lord in His mercy sets the Name within the heart,
ਪਸੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਮੁਘਦ; ਪਾਥਰ ਕਉ ਤਾਰੈ ॥
it carries across the beast, the evil spirit, the fool and the stone-hearted alike.
The Lord's Name is the medicine for every disease;
singing the Lord's virtues is the very form of good fortune and happiness.
ਕਾਹੂ ਜੁਗਤਿ; ਕਿਤੈ. ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਧਰਮਿ ॥
It is not obtained by any other method or by any religious rite;
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਿਲੈ; ਜਿਸੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮਿ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, it comes to the one for whom it is written from the first, by the Lord's mercy. ॥5॥
ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੁ ॥
One in whose mind the supreme Lord dwells,
275: that person is 'Ramdas', the Lord's servant, in the real sense of the name;
he comes to see the Lord who pervades all,
and he has found God by having the nature of a servant of servants.
One who always knows the Lord to be near,
that servant is accepted in the Lord's court.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ; ਆਪਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੈ ॥
The Lord Himself shows kindness to that servant,
ਤਿਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ; ਸਭ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਰੈ ॥
and that servant comes to understand everything.
Living among his whole family, he is unattached within;
O Nanak, by such a way of living he becomes a true 'Ramdas'. ॥6॥
One who takes God's will as sweet in his mind,
he alone is called liberated while alive;
joy and sorrow are the same to him,
he is always in bliss, for in his heart there is no separation from God.
Gold and dust are equal to him,
nectar and bitter poison are alike to him.
Whether he is treated with respect or with arrogance, it is the same to him,
and a pauper and an emperor are equal in his eyes.
Whatever God brings about is for him the right road of life;
ਨਾਨਕ. ਓਹੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ; ਕਹੀਐ ਜੀਵਨ ਮੁਕਤਿ ॥੭॥
O Nanak, that person can be called liberated while alive. ॥7॥
All places, every body that is a house, belong to the Supreme Lord;
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤੈਸਾ ਤਿਨ ਨਾਉ ॥
in whichever place He keeps beings, such is the name they come to have.
God Himself has the power to do everything and to make beings do it,
and only what pleases God comes to pass.
Becoming countless waves of life, He Himself is present everywhere;
ਲਖੇ ਨ ਜਾਹਿ; ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੇ ਰੰਗ ॥
the plays of the Supreme Lord cannot be described.
As is the understanding He gives, so is the light that shows within a being;
the Supreme Lord is Himself the doer of all and never dies.
God is always the giver of kindness,
O Nanak, and beings who keep remembering Him stay in bloom like a flower. ॥8॥9॥
ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ. ਅਨੇਕ ਜਨ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰ ॥
Many people speak of God's virtues, but no limit to those virtues is found.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਰਚਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਰਚੀ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਅਨਿਕ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, God has made this whole creation of many kinds and in many ways. ॥1॥
Many millions of beings are worshippers,
and many millions carry out religious rites and customs;
many millions live at places of pilgrimage,
and many millions, turned away from the world, roam the forests;
many millions are listeners of the Vedas,
and many millions have become great ascetics;
many millions fix their attention within themselves,
and many millions reflect on the verses that poets have composed;
many millions remember the Lord's Name, ever new each day,
ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਾ; ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥੧॥
yet, O Nanak, none of them can find the limit of the Creator. ॥1॥
and many millions are quite dry within and never soften;
ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਪਰ ਦਰਬ ਕਉ ਹਿਰਹਿ ॥
millions steal the wealth of others,
and millions speak ill of others;
millions are bound to toil for the sake of wealth,
and many millions wander in foreign lands.
ਜਿਤੁ ਜਿਤੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ; ਤਿਤੁ ਤਿਤੁ ਲਗਨਾ ॥
To whatever task You set them, O Lord, to that task beings are joined.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ; ਜਾਨੈ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, the Creator alone knows the secret of His creation. ॥2॥
There are millions of adepts and of yogis who keep lust under control,
and millions of kings who enjoy pleasures;
God has created millions of birds and snakes,
and has grown millions of stones and trees;
there are millions of winds, waters and fires,
millions of lands and circling earths;
there are many millions of moons, suns and stars,
276: ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ. ਦੇਵ ਦਾਨਵ; ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਿਰਿ ਛਤ੍ਰ ॥
millions of gods, demons and Indras with canopies over their heads;
God has strung all these beings and things on the thread of His command.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜਿਸੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਨਿਸਤਾਰੈ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, whoever pleases Him, that one God carries across. ॥3॥
Millions of beings live in Maya's three qualities of passion, darkness and goodness,
ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ. ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ; ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਅਰੁ ਸਾਸਤ ॥
millions are readers of the Vedas, Puranas, Simritis and Shastras;
He has made millions of jewels in the sea,
and has made living creatures of many kinds;
He has created millions of beings with long lives,
ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਗਿਰੀ ਮੇਰ ਸੁਵਰਨ ਥੀਵੇ ॥
and millions of golden Sumer mountains have come to be;
there are millions of yakshas, kinnars and fiends,
ਕਈ ਕੋਟਿ; ਭੂਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਸੂਕਰ ਮ੍ਰਿਗਾਚ ॥
and millions of ghosts, spirits, pigs and tigers.
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ; ਸਭਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
God is near to all of these, and far from them too.
O Nanak, the Lord is present in every place and yet remains untouched. ॥4॥
Millions of beings live in the underworld,
and millions live in hells and heavens, in suffering and in comfort;
millions are born, live and die,
and millions wander through many forms of life;
and millions labour for their bread and are worn out;
and millions are gripped by worry over Maya.
ਜਹ ਜਹ ਭਾਣਾ; ਤਹ ਤਹ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
Wherever He wishes, there He keeps beings.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੈ ਹਾਥੇ ॥੫॥
O Nanak, every matter is in God's own hand. ॥5॥
Millions of beings have become detached,
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ; ਤਿਨਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
their attention kept joined to the Name of the Lord;
and seek the Supreme Lord within themselves;
millions keep a longing for the sight of God,
and the imperishable Lord meets them.
Millions ask for the company of the holy,
and they stay in love with the Supreme Lord.
Those with whom God Himself is pleased,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤੇ ਜਨ; ਸਦਾ ਧਨਿ ਧੰਨਿ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, those people are always fortunate. ॥6॥
Through the four sources of life, in the nine regions of the earth, millions of beings have been produced,
and there are millions of beings in all the skies and universes;
millions of creatures are being born;
in many ways God has made the creation;
many times He has spread out the world,
and, drawing it in again, He always becomes the One alone;
God has created millions of beings of many kinds,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ; ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਤਿ ॥
who arise from God and merge back into God.
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਅੰਤੁ; ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one knows the limit of that Lord,
for, O Nanak, that Lord alone is like Himself. ॥7॥
Millions of beings are servants of the Supreme Lord,
and His light dawns within their souls;
millions are intimate with the source of the world,
and with their eyes they always see the One Lord everywhere;
millions enjoy the delight of the Lord's Name,
ਅਮਰ ਭਏ; ਸਦ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਜੀਵਹਿ ॥
and, freed from birth and death, they live for ever.
Millions sing the virtues of the Lord's Name,
and they remain settled in spiritual delight, in peace and in a steady state.
ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਨ ਕਉ; ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥
God keeps His devotees in mind at every breath,
for, O Nanak, those devotees are dear to God. ॥8॥10॥
ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ; ਦੂਸਰ. ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
The one Timeless Lord alone is the root cause and maker of this world; there is no other.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਤਿਸੁ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ; ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to that Lord, who is present in water, on land and in the sky. ॥1॥
God has the power to do everything and is able to prompt beings to act,
and only what pleases Him happens.
In the blink of an eye He creates the world and can destroy it too,
277: and there is no limit or boundary to His power.
Creating the universe by His command, He keeps it in place without any support;
the world arises by His command and merges back by His command.
The conduct of the high and the low is within His command,
and shows and spectacles of many kinds go on within His command.
Doing the works of His greatness, He Himself looks upon them.
O Nanak, God pervades all beings. ॥1॥
If it pleases God, He gives a person a high spiritual state,
and He carries across even the stone-hearted.
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਬਿਨੁ ਸਾਸ ਤੇ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
If God wishes, He keeps a creature safe from death even without breath,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਭਾਖੈ ॥
and when He is kind, a being sings God's virtues.
If it is the Lord's will, He saves those of fallen conduct from vices;
whatever He does, He does by His own counsel.
God Himself is the Master of this world and the next;
the knower of all hearts plays the play of the world Himself and is glad to watch it.
He does the very work that pleases Him.
O Nanak, no other like Him is to be seen. ॥2॥
ਕਹੁ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਤੇ; ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ਆਵੈ ॥
Tell me, what work can a human being do on his own?
God makes him do only what pleases God.
ਇਸ ਕੈ ਹਾਥਿ ਹੋਇ; ਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਲੇਇ ॥
If it were in this person's power, he would take hold of everything,
but God does only what He Himself likes.
Through foolishness a person becomes absorbed in Maya;
had he understanding, he would keep himself safe from it.
But his mind, lost in delusion, runs in the ten directions for the sake of Maya,
ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ; ਚਾਰਿ ਕੁੰਟ ਫਿਰਿ ਆਵੈ ॥
and in the blink of an eye it has raced round the four quarters.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸੁ ਅਪਨੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਦੇਇ ॥
Those to whom God, in His kindness, gives His devotion,
O Nanak, those people remain settled in the Name. ॥3॥
ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ; ਨੀਚ ਕੀਟ ਕਉ ਰਾਜ ॥
In an instant God gives a kingdom to one as low as a worm;
the Supreme Lord is kind to the poor.
ਜਾ ਕਾ; ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਛੂ. ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
One in whom no merit at all is seen,
him He makes known in the ten directions in a moment.
One on whom the Lord of the world bestows His gift,
ਤਾ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ; ਨ ਗਨੈ. ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
of that one's deeds He keeps no account.
ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ; ਸਭ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
This soul and body are all capital given by Him,
and in every body it is the pervading Lord's own light that shines.
He Himself has made this creation,
O Nanak, and He is glad to behold this greatness of His own. ॥4॥
ਇਸ ਕਾ ਬਲੁ; ਨਾਹੀ ਇਸੁ ਹਾਥ ॥
This being's strength is not in his own hands;
the Master of all is Himself able to do everything and have it done.
The helpless being can only walk in God's command,
ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਫੁਨਿ ਥੀਉ ॥
for only what pleases Him comes about.
At times God Himself appears among the high, at times among the low;
at times He is in sorrow, and at times He laughs in the mood of joy;
at times He makes a habit of dwelling on slander of others;
at times He rises high in the sky with joy, at times lies fallen in the underworld with worry;
at times He Himself is the knower of divine reflection.
O Nanak, He Himself is the one who unites beings with Himself. ॥5॥
Present within beings, at times God dances in many ways,
at times He stays asleep day and night;
at times, in anger, He looks most fearsome,
at times He stays as the dust of everyone's feet;
at times He sits as a great king,
at times He puts on the guise of a low-born beggar;
at times He brings ill repute upon Himself,
at times He has Himself called good.
ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਰਾਖੈ; ਤਿਵ ਹੀ ਰਹੈ ॥
A being passes his life just as God makes him live it.
O Nanak, by the Guru's grace a rare person remembers the Lord. ॥6॥
At times the all-pervading Lord, as a pandit, gives instruction to others,
at times, as a sage sworn to silence, He sits in deep meditation;
at times He bathes on the banks of pilgrimage places,
at times, as an adept or a seeker, He speaks words of knowledge;
ਕਬਹੂ; ਕੀਟ ਹਸਤਿ ਪਤੰਗ ਹੋਇ ਜੀਆ ॥
at times He is a creature such as a worm, an elephant or a moth,
and, set wandering by Himself, He roams through many forms of life;
278: like a mimic He displays forms of many kinds,
and as it pleases God, so He makes beings dance.
Only what pleases that Master happens.
O Nanak, there is no second like Him. ॥7॥
When at some time this being reaches the company of the holy,
ਉਸੁ ਅਸਥਾਨ ਤੇ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
he does not come back again from that place,
for the light of God's knowledge dawns within him,
and that state of light is never destroyed.
ਮਨ ਤਨ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ; ਇਕ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Those whose mind and body stay dyed in the Lord's Name and in His love
live always in the presence of the Supreme Lord.
ਜਿਉ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੁ; ਆਇ ਖਟਾਨਾ ॥
As water comes and blends with water,
so the soul of one settled in holy company merges in God's light;
his rounds of birth and death end, and he finds a resting place.
O Nanak, let us always be a sacrifice to God. ॥8॥11॥
ਸੁਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਮਸਕੀਨੀਆ; ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰਿ ਤਲੇ ॥
A person of humble nature, removing his sense of self and keeping low, lives in peace,
ਬਡੇ ਬਡੇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੀਆ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗਰਬਿ ਗਲੇ ॥੧॥
but the great and proud, O Nanak, simply rot away in their pride. ॥1॥
One who has the pride of kingship in his mind,
that dog earns the punishment of falling into hell.
One who thinks himself very handsome
is nothing but a maggot in filth.
One who has himself called a doer of good deeds
keeps being born and dying, wandering through many forms of life.
ਧਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਕਾ; ਜੋ ਕਰੈ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥
One who takes pride in owning wealth and land
is a fool, blind and deeply ignorant.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ; ਜਿਸ ਕੈ ਹਿਰਦੈ. ਗਰੀਬੀ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
One in whose heart God, in His kindness, sets a humble nature,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਈਹਾ ਮੁਕਤੁ; ਆਗੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
O Nanak, stays free of vices in this life and finds peace in the next world. ॥1॥
A person grows wealthy and becomes proud of it,
ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਸਮਾਨਿ; ਕਛੁ ਸੰਗਿ. ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ॥
yet at the end not so much as a straw goes with him.
ਬਹੁ ਲਸਕਰ ਮਾਨੁਖ ਊਪਰਿ; ਕਰੇ ਆਸ ॥
He rests his hopes on large armies and on men,
ਪਲ ਭੀਤਰਿ; ਤਾ ਕਾ ਹੋਇ ਬਿਨਾਸ ॥
yet in a moment he is destroyed.
He thinks himself stronger than everyone,
yet in an instant he is turned to ash.
One who becomes so proud that he cares for no one
is put to shame in the end by Dharamraj.
ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਿਟੈ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
One whose pride is wiped out by the Guru's kindness,
that person, O Nanak, is accepted in the Lord's court. ॥2॥
If a person performs millions of religious deeds and is proud of them,
all those deeds are useless, and weariness is all he gets from them.
If he practises many austerities and takes pride in them,
he too is born again and again into hells and heavens.
ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ; ਆਤਮ ਨਹੀ ਦ੍ਰਵੈ ॥
If after many efforts the heart still does not soften,
tell me, how can that person reach the Lord's court?
One who has himself called good,
goodness does not come anywhere near him.
ਸਰਬ ਕੀ ਰੇਨ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
One whose mind becomes the dust of everyone's feet,
ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ; ਤਾ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
say, O Nanak, that person's fair renown spreads. ॥3॥
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੁਝ ਤੇ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
As long as a person thinks that something can be done by him,
ਤਬ ਇਸ ਕਉ; ਸੁਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
so long he has no peace at all.
ਜਬ ਇਹ ਜਾਨੈ; ਮੈ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਤਾ ॥
As long as he thinks that he does things by his own strength,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਮਹਿ ਫਿਰਤਾ ॥
so long he stays caught in the cycle of births.
As long as he takes one person for an enemy and another for a friend,
so long his mind does not come to rest.
ਜਬ ਲਗੁ; ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਮਾਇ ॥
As long as he stays sunk in attachment to Maya,
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ; ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
The bonds of Maya break by God's kindness;
O Nanak, a person's sense of self ends by the Guru's grace. ॥4॥
ਸਹਸ ਖਟੇ; ਲਖ ਕਉ ਉਠਿ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
A person earns thousands and gets up to run after hundreds of thousands;
279: ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਮਾਇਆ ਪਾਛੈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
he keeps piling up Maya but is never satisfied.
He enjoys the many pleasures of Maya,
yet he is not content, and he wears himself out in misery.
Without contentment within, no one is satisfied;
as nothing is gained from dreams, so all his works and desires are in vain.
All peace lies in the joy of the Lord's Name,
and only someone of great fortune receives it.
The Lord who is Himself able to do everything and to have beings do it,
O Nanak, remember that Lord always. ॥5॥
God Himself is able to do everything and to have beings do it.
Think it over and see: nothing at all is in this being's hands.
As is the glance God turns on a person, so that person becomes;
that Lord is all by Himself.
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਨੋ; ਸੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਰੰਗਿ ॥
Whatever He has made, He has made in His own delight;
ਸਭ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ; ਸਭਹੂ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ॥
He is beside every being and yet apart from all.
God understands, sees and discerns everything;
He Himself is one, and He Himself takes on many forms.
ਮਰੈ ਨ ਬਿਨਸੈ; ਆਵੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
He neither dies nor perishes; He is neither born nor passes away.
O Nanak, God for ever remains settled within Himself. ॥6॥
He Himself gives the teaching and He Himself understands it,
for God Himself is joined with all beings.
He Himself has made His own expanse;
ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਉਸ ਕਾ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
everything is of His making, and He is able to make it.
ਉਸ ਤੇ ਭਿੰਨ; ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
Tell me, can anything exist apart from Him?
In every place that one Lord Himself is present.
He Himself is able to play His own plays,
and He stages spectacles of endless colours.
ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਿ; ਮਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
He Himself dwells in the minds of beings, and He holds beings in His own mind;
O Nanak, His worth cannot be told. ॥7॥
God, the Master of all, abides for ever;
by the Guru's kindness some rare person has told of this.
All that He has made is also complete, with nothing left unfinished;
among millions, some rare person has recognised this.
How lovely, how lovely is Your form,
O most beautiful, boundless and matchless Lord!
Your speech too is sweet, so sweet;
in every body it is heard through the ears and uttered by the tongue.
That person becomes pure, wholly pure,
O Nanak, who repeats the Name with love in his mind. ॥8॥12॥
ਸੰਤ ਸਰਨਿ. ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਪਰੈ; ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਉਧਰਨਹਾਰ ॥
One who comes to the shelter of the saints is saved from the bonds of Maya;
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ. ਨਾਨਕਾ; ਬਹੁਰਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਅਵਤਾਰ ॥੧॥
but, O Nanak, by slandering the saints one is born again and again. ॥1॥
By slandering a saint, a person's span of life slips away to no purpose,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਜਮ ਤੇ ਨਹੀ ਛੁਟੈ ॥
for one who slanders a saint cannot escape the messengers of death.
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸੁਖੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
By slandering a saint, all peace is lost,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਨਰਕ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
and the person falls into hell, into dreadful suffering.
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਮਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਮਲੀਨ ॥
By slandering a saint, the understanding grows foul,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸੋਭਾ ਤੇ ਹੀਨ ॥
and the person is left without honour in the world.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਹਤੇ ਕਉ; ਰਖੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one can help a person whom a saint has rebuked,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਥਾਨ ਭ੍ਰਸਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
for by slandering a saint the slanderer's heart is made filthy.
Yet if the kind saint himself shows kindness,
then, O Nanak, in the saint's company even the slanderer is saved from sins. ॥1॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੂਖਨ ਤੇ; ਮੁਖੁ ਭਵੈ ॥
By slandering a saint, the slanderer's very face is disfigured,
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਕਾਗ ਜਿਉ ਲਵੈ ॥
and he goes from place to place cawing his slander like a crow.
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸਰਪ ਜੋਨਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
By slandering a saint, a person falls into the life of a snake,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਗਦ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਿਰਮਾਇ ॥
and wanders through lowly forms of life such as worms.
ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਮਹਿ ਜਲੈ ॥
Because of slandering a saint, he burns in the fire of craving,
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਛਲੈ ॥
and he goes about deceiving everyone.
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੂਖਨਿ; ਤੇਜੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
By slandering a saint, all of a person's glory and standing are lost,
and the slanderer becomes the lowest of the low.
ਸੰਤ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਾ; ਥਾਉ ਕੋ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
Those who slander the saints are left with no support at all;
280: ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਓਇ ਭੀ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
O Nanak, if it pleases the Saints, even those slanderers reach a good state. ॥2॥
The slanderer of the Saint is forever committing outrages,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਖਿਨੁ. ਟਿਕਨੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
and does not rest from them even for an instant.
The slanderer of the Saint becomes a great tyrant,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਰਾਜ ਤੇ ਹੀਨੁ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint stays deprived of the comforts of the world,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਨਿੰਦਕੁ; ਦੁਖੀਆ ਅਰੁ ਦੀਨੁ ॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ; ਸਰਬ ਰੋਗ ॥
Every disease afflicts the one who slanders the Saints,
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਉ; ਸਦਾ ਬਿਜੋਗ ॥
for he remains forever separated from the Lord.
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ; ਦੋਖ ਮਹਿ ਦੋਖੁ ॥
To slander the Saints is a very bad deed indeed.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਉਸ ਕਾ ਭੀ. ਹੋਇ ਮੋਖੁ ॥੩॥
O Nanak, if it pleases the Saints, even that slanderer is released from slander. ॥3॥
The slanderer of the Saint always has a filthy mind,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਕਿਸੈ ਕਾ ਨਹੀ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
and so he never becomes a friend to anyone.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਡਾਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint receives punishment at the end,
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗੈ ॥
The one who slanders the Saint grows very arrogant,
and is always doing evil deeds.
The slanderer of the Saint keeps being born and dying,
ਸੰਤ ਕੀ ਦੂਖਨਾ; ਸੁਖ ਤੇ ਟਰੈ ॥
and because of slandering the Saint he is deprived of comforts.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਨਾਹੀ ਠਾਉ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint finds no support,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੪॥
but, O Nanak, if the Saint wishes, he unites that slanderer with himself. ॥4॥
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਅਧ ਬੀਚ ਤੇ ਟੂਟੈ ॥
The one who slanders the Saint is left stranded halfway,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਜਿ. ਨ ਪਹੂਚੈ ॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਉਦਿਆਨ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਈਐ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint is, as it were, made to wander wretchedly in the wilderness,
and is led off the path into desolate ground.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਅੰਤਰ ਤੇ ਥੋਥਾ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint is empty within,
ਜਿਉ ਸਾਸ ਬਿਨਾ; ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕੀ ਲੋਥਾ ॥
as a dead body is without breath.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ; ਜੜ ਕਿਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
The slanderers of the Saint have no firm foundation at all,
what they themselves sow, they themselves eat.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ॥
No one else can save the one who slanders the Saint,
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੰਤ ਭਾਵੈ; ਤਾ ਲਏ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥੫॥
but, O Nanak, if the Saint wishes, he can save him. ॥5॥
The slanderer of the Saint wails
as a fish writhes without water.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ ਭੂਖਾ; ਨਹੀ ਰਾਜੈ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint, stricken by craving, is never satisfied,
as fire is never satisfied with fuel.
The slanderer of the Saint is left lying alone and forsaken,
ਜਿਉ ਬੂਆੜੁ ਤਿਲੁ; ਖੇਤ ਮਾਹਿ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
like a sesame plant burnt out inside, left forlorn in the field.
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਧਰਮ ਤੇ ਰਹਤ ॥
The slanderer of the Saint is without righteousness,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਸਦ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਕਹਤ ॥
ਕਿਰਤੁ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ; ਧੁਰਿ ਹੀ ਪਇਆ ॥
The slanderer's nature, the fruit of his earlier slander, has followed him from the very beginning.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ; ਸੋਈ ਥਿਆ ॥੬॥
O Nanak, whatever pleases Him is what happens. ॥6॥
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਬਿਗੜ ਰੂਪੁ ਹੋਇ ਜਾਇ ॥
The one who slanders the Saints becomes corrupted,
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕਉ; ਦਰਗਹ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
and receives punishment in the Lord's court.
The slanderer of the Saints is always in distress,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਨ ਮਰੈ. ਨ ਜੀਵਾਈਐ ॥
he is neither among the living nor among the dead.
ਸੰਤ ਕੇ ਦੋਖੀ ਕੀ; ਪੁਜੈ ਨ ਆਸਾ ॥
The hope of the Saint's slanderer is never fulfilled,
ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਦੋਖੀ; ਉਠਿ ਚਲੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
ਸੰਤ ਕੈ ਦੋਖਿ; ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
No one is freed from this thirst for slander by slandering the Saint.
As a person's intention is, so his nature becomes.
No one can erase the accumulated fruit of past deeds.
O Nanak, that true Lord knows this secret. ॥7॥
ਸਭ ਘਟ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ; ਓਹੁ ਕਰਨੈਹਾਰੁ ॥
All beings are His, and He alone has the power to do everything,
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ; ਕਰਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
Sing the Lord's praises day and night,
ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕੀਆ ॥
Every play in the world unfolds as He sets it going,
as the Lord makes each being, so that being becomes.
He alone is able to play His own game of the world.
Who else could offer Him counsel?
